summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) of CipherBox using the GSD workflow — research, generate 4 PLAN.md files in 2 waves, verify them, then begin wave execution.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (4 plans, 2 waves, 0 blockers, HARD-09 covered). Wave 1 execution was partially complete: 58-01 finished after a crash+continuation, 58-02 was spawned but the transcript ends mid-execution.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core — cross-language verify vectors must live in crates/fuse/tests/, not crates/crypto/tests/
The 58-02 upsertFolderIpns tightening class previously broke 48/89 SDK E2E tests, making it the highest-risk plan in the phase
Local stack for E2E gates: redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo — all were running and usable
Feature branch feat/ipns-signature-verify-coverage was pre-checked-out; execute-phase detected no worktree base degradation
RESEARCH.md open-questions headings require an explicit '(RESOLVED)' marker once questions are addressed in-plan, or the plan checker flags a warning

code.finding: ciborium dep was added here by the 58-01 executor; a stale mid-execution diagnostic incorrectly claimed it was missing
New file: resolve_ipns_verified wrapper created as the single chokepoint routing all 9 FUSE resolve sites through CBOR cid/sequence verification

workflow: GSD commit_failed response is a known false negative — always verify with git log rather than retrying the commit
Sequential executors on the feature branch are preferred over parallel worktree execution for security/crypto phases due to prior incidents with cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees
Cosmetic plan-checker warnings (missing heading markers) can be fixed inline without burning a full planner revision cycle
When a subagent hits an API socket error mid-task, assess git state and uncommitted diff before spawning a continuation — partial commits from the crashed agent may be valid and should not be re-done
--chain flag auto-advances from plan-phase to execute-phase without user intervention

friction: 58-01 executor hit an API socket error (connection closed) mid-task-3, losing the completion signal and leaving Task 3 done-but-uncommitted and Task 4 unstarted

RESEARCH.md open-questions section lacked (RESOLVED) markers, triggering a plan-checker warning that required a separate fix commit
